english.title: Offer transferable securities to UK public when an approved prospectus was not made available
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), offered transferable securities to which section 85(1) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 applied to the public in the United Kingdom when an approved prospectus had not been made available to the public before the offer was made
english.legislation: Contrary to section 85(1) and (3) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000.

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) Section 85(5) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 provides that section 85(1) applies to all transferable activities other than:-
(a) those listed in Schedule 11A;
(b) such other transferable securities as may be specified in prospectus rules.
(ii)"Approved prospectus" means, in relation to transferable securities to which this section applies, a prospectus approved by the competent authority of the home State in relation to the issuer of the securities.
(iii) Section 401 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 provides that proceedings for offences may be instituted in England and Wales only by the Authority or the Secretary of State or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and of a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
